summary: Structured control-flow region ops: scope / if / for / foreach + the yield terminator (sec 13/14).

ops.name: delay
ops.summary: A one-step delay register (sec 20 delay<T>): `current` = `init` on the first evaluation, thereafter the `next` from the PREVIOUS evaluation.
ops.docs: core.delay(%init, %next) -> %current. A one-evaluation delay/register (audio delay lines, TAA history taps): %current is %init on the first-ever evaluation, thereafter the %next of the PREVIOUS evaluation. The cell PERSISTS across evaluations (it does not reset on region re-entry). Structurally identical to core.state; the distinction is the executor's update timing (CEIR-5z).

operands.name: next
operands.doc: the value delayed by one evaluation (the FEEDBACK operand)

ops.name: for
ops.summary: A counted loop: run the body for each index in [lower, upper) stepping by step.
ops.docs: core.for(%lo, %hi, %step) { ^body(%iv): ... }. The body region's entry block takes the induction variable.

ops.name: foreach
ops.summary: Iterate a collection / view / work-set: run the body once per element.
ops.docs: core.foreach(%items) { ^body(%elem): ... }. The body region's entry block takes the current element.

operands.name: items
operands.doc: the collection / view / work-set to iterate

ops.name: history
ops.summary: A depth-N history buffer (sec 20 history<T>): a delay line keeping the previous `depth` values (default 1).
ops.docs: core.history(%init, %next) -> %current, with an optional int `depth` attribute (RESERVED vocabulary; ABSENT = 1, PRESENT must be an Int >= 1 -- validated trait-generically by the CEIR-5d verifier as StateDepthInvalid). A ring of the previous `depth` values (GI/exposure histories); the cell PERSISTS across evaluations (it does not reset on region re-entry). NOT Pure (a distinct cell). persistent_resource<T> (sec 20's fourth construct) is NOT here -- it routes to ceir.resource (sec 36), a resource-lifetime concern, not a control-flow cell.

operands.name: next
operands.doc: the value pushed into the history (the FEEDBACK operand)

results.name: current
results.doc: the current head of the history (depth taps land at CEIR-5z)

ops.name: if
ops.summary: Run the THEN region when the condition is nonzero, else the ELSE region; both yield the (variadic) results.
ops.docs: core.if(%cond) -> (%r...) { then } { else }. A constant %cond folds via Context::fold_constant_if (RAUW the results with the taken yield).

results.name: results
results.doc: the taken region's yielded values (0 or more)

ops.name: match
ops.summary: Structural pattern match: run the arm region selected by matching the scrutinee.
ops.docs: core.match(%scrutinee) { arm0 } { arm1 } ... -- STRUCTURAL only (each arm a region); PATTERN semantics are CHIR's.

operands.name: scrutinee
operands.doc: the value to match against the arms

ops.name: scope
ops.summary: A structured scope: unconditionally run its region; its yield forwards to the op's (variadic) results.
ops.docs: core.scope { ... core.yield %v... } -- the region's yield produces the op's results (per-result TYPES join at CEIR-6).

results.name: results
results.doc: the region's yielded values (0 or more)

ops.name: state
ops.summary: An explicit persistent state cell (sec 20 state<T>): `current` = `init` on the first evaluation of the enclosing region instance, thereafter the previous `next`.
ops.docs: core.state(%init, %next) -> %current. The sec 20 state<T> primitive: %current is %init on the FIRST-EVER evaluation of the op and the previous evaluation's %next thereafter. The cell is PER STATIC OP INSTANCE and PERSISTS across evaluations -- it does NOT reset on region re-entry. StateEdge -> %next (the last operand) is the feedback edge. NOT Pure: each instance is a distinct cell. Executor semantics land at CEIR-5z.

operands.name: next
operands.doc: the value to store for the next evaluation (the FEEDBACK operand -- may forward-reference)

ops.name: switch
ops.summary: Multi-way branch: run the case region selected by the integer selector.
ops.docs: core.switch(%sel) { case0 } { case1 } ... -- N variadic case regions, one selected at runtime by %sel.

ops.name: while
ops.summary: A while loop: repeat the body region while the condition region yields true.
ops.docs: core.while { cond: ... core.yield %bool } { body: ... }. The cond region yields the loop test (its yield count=1 + bool-ness verified at CEIR-5b; loop-carried values are 5d state ops).

ops.name: yield
ops.summary: Terminate a structured region's block (the region terminator).
ops.docs: core.yield ends a structured region's block (a Terminator like func.return) and forwards its operands to the region owner's results. The operand-count = owner-result-count contract is enforced at its consumer (the fold); the general region-walking verifier is CEIR-5b.

operands.name: values
operands.doc: zero or more yielded values (forwarding to owner results is 5a remaining)
